title: Used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City: prices and checks
description: What used sofas were listed at in Ho Chi Minh City in November 2026, how to check one for bed bugs and a weak frame, cleaning prices and delivery.
h1: Buying a used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City: what it costs and what to check before it comes home
intro: A used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City is a good buy if three things check out: the frame is solid, the cushions smell clean and the seams show no bed bugs. Check all three in the seller's room, before the sofa is loaded. Size and material set the price more than age does. In November 2026 Chợ Tốt alone listed 8,953 tables, chairs and sofas in the city, so walking away from a doubtful one costs you little.
keyPoints: Size and material set the price. On Chợ Tốt in November 2026, used sofas were listed at anything from {{vnd:400000}} for a velvet sofa in Tân Phú to {{vnd:8500000}} for a leather set.

The US EPA advises checking secondhand couches for bed bugs **before** you bring them home. Look in the seams, between the cushions and underneath for live bugs, pale shed skins, tiny eggs and dark spots.
Smell every cushion. In Saigon's humidity a mould smell in the foam does not go away.
A professional clean costs about {{vnd:200000-350000}} for a 2–3 seat fabric sofa in Ho Chi Minh City, according to Báo Văn Hóa in January 2026.
Get the delivery price for your district and floor before you agree the sofa's price. Alleys a truck cannot enter and tight stairwell turns are where moving costs go up.

sections.title: How much does a used sofa cost in Ho Chi Minh City?

blocks.text: Prices for used sofas in Ho Chi Minh City vary widely, and size and material matter more than age. On [Chợ Tốt's Ho Chi Minh City furniture page](https://www.chotot.com/mua-ban-ban-ghe-tp-ho-chi-minh) in November 2026, used sofas ran from {{vnd:400000}} for an old velvet sofa to {{vnd:8500000}} for a leather set.

blocks.caption: Sofa asking prices on Chợ Tốt, Ho Chi Minh City, as read in November 2026 (listings change daily)
rows: Fabric L-shaped corner sofa, 2.4 m × 80 cm, cream
Brown fabric L-shaped sofa, for comparison

blocks.text: These are asking prices, not selling prices. A new fabric L-shaped sofa was listed for less than the used leather set, so compare a used piece with what the same money buys new before you haggle. Listings still use the old district names. Since July 2025, official addresses use the new ward names instead, so check a seller's ward on a map before you set off.
For prices of other used furniture and appliances in the city, see [secondhand furniture in Ho Chi Minh City](/secondhand-furniture-ho-chi-minh-city).

sections.title: Where can you buy a used sofa in Saigon?

blocks.text: There are three main places to look: online classifieds, where individuals and people leaving Vietnam sell, the city's used-goods streets, and used-furniture chains that refurbish and resell. Classifieds usually have the most choice and let you see the sofa in the home it came from.

blocks.caption: Where used sofas are sold in Ho Chi Minh City
rows: Online classifieds ([eno.vn furniture and appliances](/c/furniture-appliances), Chợ Tốt)
Sofas from private sellers, often people moving out, with photos and a district
You inspect and arrange transport yourself
Tuoi Tre reported in August 2016 that more than 20 secondhand shops stood along 3 km of Kha Van Can Street in Thu Duc, with more on Pham Van Bach Street in Tan Binh
That report is old, so check shops are still trading before you go
VnExpress reported in January 2019 that around 10 chains each ran two or three stores, mostly in the suburbs, and that one, Vinasave, sold refurbished items at 40–70% of the new price
Stock changes. Ask what was repaired

blocks.text: Expats leaving Saigon often sell a whole flat's furniture at once, sofa included, which suits you if you are furnishing from scratch. eno.vn's [furniture and appliances listings](/c/furniture-appliances) are the place to start if you want to message a seller in English. If nothing there fits, put up a wanted post at [/post](/post).

blocks.title: Check the lease first
blocks.text: If your flat is let furnished, the landlord may already owe you a sofa or may not want a second one brought in. Read [renting an apartment in Vietnam as a foreigner](/renting-an-apartment-vietnam-foreigner) before you buy.

sections.title: What should you check before buying a used sofa?

blocks.text: Check the frame, the smell and the seams, in that order, in the seller's room and before you pay. The US EPA [advises checking secondhand furniture, beds and couches](https://www.epa.gov/bedbugs/protecting-your-home-bed-bugs) for bed bugs before bringing them home, because that is how bed bugs arrive in a new home.

items.title: Sit in every seat
items.text: Try the corners and the middle, and press the arms where the frame is thinnest. A creak, a dip or a seat that tilts means a broken or loose rail.

items.title: Look underneath
items.text: Tip the sofa back. A solid timber frame that is screwed and braced will outlast stapled board, and you can see which you have from below.

items.title: Smell the cushions
items.text: Unzip a cushion if you can and smell the foam. Saigon's humidity holds a mould smell in, and cleaning rarely gets it out.

items.title: Check the seams and folds
items.text: Take every cushion off and use a phone torch along the piping, the seams and the gaps where the back meets the seat.

items.title: Work the moving parts
items.text: Open and close a sofa bed or recliner fully, twice. Ask the seller to show you it working rather than taking their word.

items.title: Agree delivery before price
items.text: Ask what it costs to deliver to your district and your floor before you settle the sofa's price.

blocks.text: What do bed bugs look like on a sofa?

According to the [US EPA's guide to finding bed bugs](https://www.epa.gov/bedbugs/how-find-bed-bugs), the signs are rusty or reddish stains, dark spots that look like a marker has bled, tiny pale-yellow eggs about 1 mm across, pale shed skins and the live bugs themselves. On couches the EPA points to the seams of chairs and couches and the gaps between cushions. If you see any of these, walk away. Do not try to treat that sofa.
Is a used sofa from a smoker or pet owner worth it?
Usually not, unless the covers come off. Smoke and pet smells sit in the foam as well as the fabric. Ask the seller directly and trust your nose over the photos.

sections.title: How much does it cost to clean a used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City?

blocks.text: Professional sofa cleaning at home costs from about {{vnd:200000}} for a small fabric sofa to about {{vnd:600000}} for a leather set, according to Báo Văn Hóa in January 2026. It is worth budgeting for, even on a sofa that passed every check.

blocks.caption: Typical sofa cleaning prices in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, from Báo Văn Hóa, 12 January 2026

blocks.text: The [Báo Văn Hóa report](https://baovanhoa.vn/doi-song/gia-don-nha-theo-gio-giat-sofa-2026-ra-sao-196828.html) says size and material drive the price. It was written in the run-up to Tết, when demand for cleaners peaks, so book early if you buy in January or February. Cleaning freshens a sofa and lifts stains. It is not a fix for a sofa that already shows signs of bed bugs.

sections.title: How do you get a used sofa home?

blocks.text: Most buyers either pay the seller's own delivery or book a moving service. Either way, get the price for your district and your floor before you agree to buy. The cost goes up when a truck cannot get down your alley and the last stretch has to be carried by hand.

items: **Measure the stairwell turn, not just the door.** A 3-seat or L-shaped sofa that fits the door can still jam on a narrow landing in a tube house.
**Ask about lifts in apartment blocks.** Some buildings restrict furniture moves to certain hours or ask for notice. Check with building management.
**Wrap it.** In the rainy season, a sofa carried uncovered down an alley gets soaked.

blocks.text: [Saigon Moving](/saigonmoving), an official eno.vn partner, moves furniture and lists its own prices, which vary by move. Its [moving guide](/guides/saigonmoving) explains what goes into the price.

sections.title: How do you sell a used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City?

blocks.text: Post it on a classifieds site with clear photos, the measurements, the material, the district and an honest note on wear. Then let buyers come and sit on it. Sofas sell faster when the price includes delivery or the listing says plainly that the buyer arranges it.

You can list a sofa in eno.vn's [furniture and appliances](/c/furniture-appliances) category from [/post](/post). If you are leaving Vietnam and selling everything, [selling up before you leave Vietnam](/selling-up-before-you-leave-vietnam) covers timing and what to sell first. To meet buyers safely, see [safety on eno.vn](/safety).

sections.title: What this guide does not cover

items: Buying a new sofa or furnishing a whole flat: see [furnishing a home in Vietnam](/furnishing-a-home-in-vietnam).
Prices of other used furniture and appliances: see [secondhand furniture in Ho Chi Minh City](/secondhand-furniture-ho-chi-minh-city).
Treating a bed bug problem already in your home: that is a job for a licensed pest-control company, and if you rent, tell your landlord.
Used sofas in Hanoi or Da Nang: the checks are the same, but the prices above are for Ho Chi Minh City only.

faqs.q: Is it safe to buy a used sofa?
faqs.a: Buying a used sofa is safe if you check it before it comes home. The US EPA advises checking secondhand couches for bed bugs before bringing them inside: look along the seams, between the cushions and underneath for stains, dark spots, tiny pale eggs and shed skins. Also sit in every seat to test the frame, and smell the cushions for mould. If any of these checks fails, walk away.

faqs.q: How much is a used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Used sofa prices in Ho Chi Minh City depend mainly on size and material. On Chợ Tốt in November 2026, the dearest used sofa shown, a leather set, was asking about twenty times the price of the cheapest, an old velvet sofa. A new fabric L-shaped sofa was listed for less than the used leather set. The cost section of this guide gives the exact asking prices, and many sellers will negotiate.

faqs.q: How do you check a used couch for bed bugs?
faqs.a: To check a used couch for bed bugs, take off every cushion and shine a torch along the seams, the piping and the gap between the seat and the back, then tip the couch to look underneath. The US EPA lists rusty or reddish stains, dark marker-like spots, pale eggs about 1 mm across, shed skins and live bugs as the signs. If you find any, do not take the couch home.

faqs.q: Where can I buy a second hand sofa in Saigon?
faqs.a: Second-hand sofas in Saigon are sold on online classifieds such as eno.vn's furniture and appliances category and Chợ Tốt, in used-goods shops and through used-furniture chains. Tuoi Tre reported in 2016 that Kha Van Can Street in Thu Duc and Pham Van Bach Street in Tan Binh had clusters of secondhand shops, so check they are still trading. Expats leaving the city often sell whole flats of furniture at once.

faqs.q: How much does sofa cleaning cost in Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: Sofa cleaning in Ho Chi Minh City is priced by size and material. According to Báo Văn Hóa in January 2026, a 2–3 seat fabric sofa costs the least, an L-shaped corner sofa costs more, and a leather set costs the most. The cleaning section of this guide gives the price ranges. Book early in the weeks before Tết, when demand for home cleaning peaks.

faqs.q: How do I get a used sofa delivered in Ho Chi Minh City?
faqs.a: A used sofa in Ho Chi Minh City is usually delivered by the seller's own transport or by a moving service. Ask for the delivery price for your district and floor before you agree the sofa's price. Measure your stairwell turn as well as the door, and warn the mover if a truck cannot enter your alley, because carrying the sofa by hand costs extra.

faqs.q: What should I check on a used sofa bed?
faqs.a: On a used sofa bed, check the folding mechanism as well as the usual frame, smell and bed bug checks. Ask the seller to open and close the sofa bed fully twice while you watch, and listen for grinding or a frame that sticks. Then lie on the opened bed to feel for broken slats or springs, and check the hinges and the fabric folds for bed bug signs.
